summary.name: JackDB
summary.one_liner: JackDB is a secure, collaborative database management platform and SQL editor with role-based and time-based access controls.
use_cases: Giving teams controlled access to production databases
Running and sharing SQL queries across an organization
Deploying database access tooling on-premises or in the cloud
summary.what_it_does: The page describes JackDB as a platform for working with data securely across an organization. It says it safeguards databases with role-based access control (RBAC) and time-based permissions. The enterprise version is described as supporting on-premises, hybrid cloud, and cloud-hosted deployments. It also states integration with Single Sign-On (SSO), LDAP, Active Directory, and SAML-based authentication. The page text is brief and does not detail specific query editor features or supported database engines.
notable: Role-based access control (RBAC) plus time-based permissions
Deployment options: on-premises, hybrid cloud, or cloud-hosted
SSO, LDAP, Active Directory, and SAML authentication support
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Listing in awesome-mac is for the Mac context only; page does not name macOS support
